power.diagnosis: The median test resolves +0.0068 against proposals of about +0.0028, so a refusal here does carry information about the change itself.
power.note: The campaign was blind to true effects below the median MDE. A refusal is evidence against effects LARGER than a test's MDE and says nothing about effects smaller than it.

programme.retraction_note: 32 verdict(s) were produced under a protocol since found to be looser than advertised — v1: the replication pool overlapped the gate and the charged alpha was never applied; v2: a negative suppression null was subtracted, and significance came from a percentile endpoint that 400 resamples could not estimate. Their refusals stand; their acceptances are retracted and may be asked again.
programme.findings_vs_expected_false: 0 finding(s) against 0.044 expected by chance, plus 1 retracted under an earlier protocol
programme.interpretation: Cumulative alpha over every test in every campaign IS the expected number of false findings for the whole programme. Compare it to the finding count. A campaign is never re-run against a hypothesis it has already tested, which is what stops the count from being shopped.

summary.note: A low acceptance rate is the expected outcome. This project has falsified eleven method families; the gate refusing is the gate working.
